notes:
{小|ちい}さな is a ⟦{連体詞|れんたいし}→連体詞：noentry⟧ (pre-noun adjectival) — a special word class that can only modify nouns directly. It cannot be conjugated or used as a predicate.

COMPARISON WITH {小|ちい}さい:
- {小|ちい}さな + noun: pre-noun form only ({小|ちい}さな⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧)
- ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ + noun: i-adjective form (⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧)
- Both are interchangeable before nouns, but only ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ works as a predicate: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ (NOT {小|ちい}さな)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ (big — same pre-noun adjectival type)
- ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (big — i-adjective)

Note: {小|ちい}さな and ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ are the only common ⟦{連体詞|れんたいし}→連体詞：noentry⟧ with corresponding い-adjective forms. Most 連体詞 (like ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧, ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧) have no adjective counterpart.
